rules.edit_policy: Only change passes after acceptance criteria genuinely pass. Never delete a feature to make progress look better.
rules.priority_policy: Work lowest priority number first when dependencies pass.

features.title: Investigation workspace UI
acceptance: run investigation streams and persists, refresh reconstructs without rerunning the model
features.notes: The bottom composer ("Tell Crado what you measured, changed or observed") is MVP-10's job — its own acceptance criteria are 'observation persists' / 'analysis can update evidence/hypothesis'. MVP-09's explicit scope (per the ticket instructions actually given) was the read/run/stream/reconstruct workspace, not the composer, so 'composer records observation' was dropped here and left to MVP-10 where it's the actual deliverable.

features.title: Engineering Knowledge Base (document storage, ingestion, hybrid retrieval)
acceptance: workspace-isolated document storage with real RLS, private Supabase Storage
PDF/TXT/Markdown ingestion: extract -> chunk -> embed -> store -> mark indexed, with a PDF with no extractable text marked failed (not silently indexed)
every chunk retains provenance: documentId, filename, page or section, product/revision relationship
searchEngineeringDocuments() does hybrid (keyword + semantic) retrieval via Postgres/pgvector, no separate vector DB
Documents/Sources UI: real counts only, real status (UPLOADING/PROCESSING/INDEXED/FAILED), source preview with highlighted passage
pagination and workspace/product/revision filtering verified against a 120-document programmatic dataset, not just a handful
workspace isolation verified for documents, chunks, search, and Storage (download/list/upload/delete all rejected cross-workspace, including a guessed exact path)
features.notes: The Investigation Agent (MVP-10B) and citation/source drawer (MVP-10C) are separate follow-on tickets that build on this. The 'semantic' half of retrieval is a zero-dependency local hashed lexical embedding (src/lib/documents/embedding.ts), not a neural embedding model — no embeddings API key is configured, and adding a new third-party credential is a one-way-door decision per CLAUDE.md, not made unasked. Swapping in a real embedding provider later is a drop-in change behind the same EmbeddingAdapter-shaped function signature.

features.title: Investigation Agent (ToolLoopAgent orchestration layer)
acceptance: one Investigation Agent (src/lib/agents), built on AI SDK ToolLoopAgent, with exactly six bounded tools: getProductContext, getMeasurementContext, getDeterministicCorrelations, searchEngineeringDocuments, getPreviousRevisions, getPreviousInvestigations
deterministic correlation (MVP-06) stays guaranteed and unchanged; the agent only runs after real candidates exist, and never recomputes them
structured output only (Zod, via Output.object) — hypotheses[] with reasoning/evidenceRefs/missingEvidence/nextInvestigation, clarificationQuestion, investigationStatus; no free-form prose contract

independent post-hoc validation rejects hallucinated productFactId/certainty language (whole hypothesis) and hallucinated or mismatched document/fact/investigation citations (that one citation only), reusing MVP-07's buildObservedEvidence/buildKnownEvidence/containsProhibitedCertaintyLanguage rather than reimplementing them
bounded tool loop: explicit stopWhen at 9 steps, not the SDK's 20-step default; a model that never produces a final answer fails the run cleanly rather than looping

observable, safe agent.started/agent.tool.completed/agent.completed events (tool name, safe label, result count, durationMs, query) — never hidden reasoning or a raw prompt; persisted and reconstructed exactly like existing analysis_events

truthful agent.completed metrics (documentsAvailable/documentSearches/passagesRetrieved/passagesUsedAsEvidence/deterministicRelationshipsChecked/nextInvestigationCount) computed from real tool-call results, never fabricated
fully backward compatible: createAnalysisRunForFailureCase's agentModel option and runAnalysis's agentRunner are additive/optional — every MVP-08/09 test passes unchanged with neither supplied

live-verified against a real Gateway X case (40 MHz clock, WiFi radio, unshielded display cable, one seeded test-report document, 200 MHz/+7.4dB measurement): full event sequence including 5 document searches, 2 evidence-labeled hypotheses with real document citations (filename+section+exact quoted passage) and no root-cause/certainty language, persisted rows match the stream exactly
features.notes: The polished agent-activity UI (source drawer, live tool-call panel) is MVP-10C, not built here — this ticket is the orchestration layer and its backend event/reducer foundation only. The live test uncovered and fixed two real defects: reasoning/nextInvestigation needed wider Zod bounds (600/300 -> 1200/500 chars) for the agent's evidence-integrated answers, and the tool-activity label pluralizer was naively appending 's' to two-word nouns ('passage retrieveds') — fixed to pluralize the noun only ('passages retrieved'), covered by a regression test.
